reviews.text: I LOVE IT Honestly, I’m obsessed with this setting spray!! 😭💗 It makes my makeup look so much more flawless and keeps everything in place without making my face feel heavy or sticky. My makeup looks fresh, smooth, and beautiful for hours, and I love how it brings everything together for that perfect finished look. Definitely one of those products that makes a difference in your makeup routine. 100% recommend!! 🎀✨
reviews.zh: 我真係超鍾意！老實講，我對呢款定妝噴霧好著迷！！😭💗 佢令我嘅妝容完美咗好多，又可以固定所有嘢，而且唔會令面覺得沉重或者黏膩。我嘅妝容維持好幾個鐘都新鮮、順滑、好靚，我好鍾意佢將所有嘢融合埋一齊，令妝容完成得好完美。絕對係嗰啲令你嘅化妝程序有分別嘅產品之一。100%推薦！！🎀✨

reviews.text:
This setting spray completely lives up to its cult-favorite reputation! If you are tired of your makeup fading, creasing, or melting away by mid-afternoon, this product is an absolute game-changer.
The mist itself is exceptionally fine and disperses evenly across the face without leaving any heavy water droplets or ruining your base application. It creates a weightless, comfortable layer that locks everything from foundation to eye makeup in place all day long. Instead of feeling tight or drying like many heavy-duty fixing sprays, the inclusion of hydrating ingredients keeps the skin feeling balanced and fresh.
reviews.zh:
呢款定妝噴霧真係名不虛傳，係一款人人推崇嘅經典產品！如果你厭倦咗化妝到下午就花、摺縫，或者融晒，呢款產品絕對係大改變。
噴霧本身霧粒非常細，可以均勻噴喺面上，唔會留低厚厚嘅水珠，亦唔會破壞底妝。佢形成一層輕盈、舒服嘅保護膜，由粉底到眼妝都可以成日固定喺位。唔似好多厚重嘅定妝噴霧會令皮膚緊繃或者乾燥，呢款加咗保濕成分，令皮膚保持平衡同清新。

reviews.text: if you're thinking of getting this GET IT!!! i used to think setting sprays were a scam but proved me wrong.. it helps my makeup stay in place allll day especially my eyeliner. i tried using the same eyeliner without the setting spray and it smudged after like an hour of wear, but with this setting spray the same eyeliner lasted the whole day (8 hours+)!!!! i never go out witthout using this setting spray first. the mist is sooo fine i literally couldn't tell if it was landing on my face when i first sprayed it lol
reviews.zh: 如果你諗緊要唔要買，就快啲買！！！我以前都覺得定妝噴霧係騙人嘅，但係呢款令我改觀咗……佢令我個妝成日都固定得好好，特別係我嘅眼線。我試過同一支眼線筆唔用定妝噴霧，大約一個鐘就花咗，但係用咗呢款定妝噴霧，同一支眼線筆可以撐一日（8個鐘以上）！！！！我出門一定先用呢款定妝噴霧。噴霧超幼，我第一次噴嗰陣真係分唔到有冇噴喺面上，哈哈。

reviews.text: Honestly, it's been a game-changer for me. I've been using it religiously, and I'm amazed at how well it works. My makeup stays flawless for hours on end, even through long days at work or nights out with friends. The best part? It feels so lightweight and comfortable on my skin. I love that I can trust it to keep my look intact without feeling like I'm wearing a ton of product. If you're in the market for a reliable setting spray, this one definitely gets my vote!!! ><
reviews.zh: 老實講，對我嚟講真係一大改變。我每日都堅持用，對佢嘅效果真係好驚訝。我嘅妝容可以維持好多個鐘都完美無瑕，即使返工嘅長日子或者同朋友夜晚出去都一樣。最好嘅係，佢摸落皮膚好輕盈、舒服。我好鍾意可以信賴佢保持到我嘅妝容，而唔會覺得臉上好似塗咗好多嘢。如果你想搵一款可靠嘅定妝噴霧，呢款絕對係我投畀嘅一票！！！ ><

reviews.text:
You might not know what Jodel is so I'll explain it quickly; it's a mostly nordic/german based anonymous phone app for forum-like chatting. 

There's a channel called "asianbeauty" for mostly korean/japanese skincare and makeup, and I found people recommending this product there. I was convinced since my ABH setting spray was running out anyway, and this beats it 100-0. It sprays a really fine spray that sets your makeup for good for the whole day. 

So here's two pics of me with my makeup set with this, I literally went out to university in the morning in a cold breezy wind and some snowing, then got home and took a 3 hour nap and my makeup was still fine, just some usual shine on my nose and forehead since my T-zone is a bit on the oily side. Definitely recommending this!
reviews.zh:
你可能唔知 Jodel 係咩，我快啲解釋吓：佢主要係一款源自北歐／德國嘅匿名手機應用程式，類似論壇式聊天。

裏面有個叫「asianbeauty」嘅頻道，主要討論韓國／日本嘅護膚同化妝，我喺度見到有人推薦呢款產品。我本身嘅 ABH 定妝噴霧都快用完，而呢款完勝佢（100 比 0），所以我就信咗。佢噴出嚟嘅霧粒好幼，可以將妝容定住成日。

所以呢度有兩張我化咗呢款妝嘅相。我朝早喺寒風同落細雪嘅情況下去大學，之後返到屋企瞓咗三個鐘，妝容仲係好好，只係鼻同額頭有啲正常嘅油光，因為我個 T 字位有啲油。絕對推薦！

reviews.text: I love this product! Had to get a refill since I ran out (one bottle is 75mL) . This setting spray is so good at keeping my makeup stay in place all day!💕It has a little bit of a powdery fragrance when you spray it. Great use for natural to glam makeup. I like to follow it up with a setting powder on my routine to make it extra flawless. For students, this definitely saves you from school air/lighting AND it’s pink. 🔛🔝
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款產品！用完咗，所以要再買過一支（一支 75mL）。呢款定妝噴霧好好，可以令我成日都保持妝容，非常好！💕噴嘅時候有少少粉質香味。由自然妝到華麗妝都好啱用。我平時會跟住用定妝散粉，令妝容更加完美。對學生嚟講，呢款絕對可以幫你應付學校嘅空氣同燈光，而且係粉紅色嘅！🔛🔝

reviews.text: I use this to set my makeup on prom and it did not budge. We had prom on a boat where e spent most of the evening/night dancing on the deck. So summer heat, sweat and everything that goes along with dancing with a few hundred people outside during summer. I was outside from 3pm to 11pm. When I came back home, my make up had not budged. Foundation looking fine, eyeshadow looking awesome, everything looked the same. 100% would recommend this to anyone who wants their makeup to stay on looking the same all day.
reviews.zh: 我用呢款定住畢業舞會嘅妝，完全冇移位。我哋喺一隻船上舉行畢業舞會，大部分時間都喺甲板上跳舞。夏天嘅炎熱、汗水，同埋同幾百人喺戶外跳舞所帶嚟嘅一切都有。我由下午三點一直喺外面到晚上十一點。返到屋企嗰陣，我嘅妝一啲都冇移位。粉底睇落好好，眼影好靚，一切都同之前一樣。我百分百推薦畀任何想成日都保持妝容一樣嘅人。

reviews.text:
this spray is good to be used with usual ways by spraying over your face after you did all makeup. 

but I have read an article about this tricks that make your makeup lasts WHOLE DAY! 

So after you did all the base skincare (toner, essence, moisturiser and sunscreen) apply luminescent powder and spray with finishing spray. 
Then apply foundation and finish up all your makeup as usual and at then end apply another powder and finishing spray. :) 

I have tried either way works but I think this tricks keeps my makeup lasts longer and I do it if I have to do 12 hours shifts.
reviews.zh:
呢款噴霧用普通方法都好好用，就係化完妝之後喺面上噴一噴。

但係我睇過一篇文章，講緊令妝容可以維持成日嘅小技巧！

所以係做完所有底層護膚（爽膚水、精華、保濕霜同防曬）之後，拍上有光澤感嘅散粉，再噴定妝噴霧。
然後搽粉底，照常完成全部化妝，最後再拍多一層散粉，再噴定妝噴霧。:)

我試過兩種方法都有效，但我覺得呢個小技巧令我嘅妝容維持得更耐，所以如果我要做 12 個鐘嘅更，我就會咁做。
